modules.title: Events Planning And Management
modules.summary: This Event, Planning, and Management course provides participants with comprehensive insights into the diverse aspects of event planning and management. From foundational concepts to practical skills in marketing, execution, and evaluation, individuals will be prepared for roles ranging from Event Manager to Virtual Events Planner. Addressing ethical considerations, risk management, legal issues, and current technology trends, this course fosters a holistic understanding of the thriving events industry and its impact on tourism destinations.
